title: Origin story: Bastet
description: Bastet was the cat-headed goddess, daughter of Ra, gentle protector of homes and fierce defender against evil spirits and disease. Her cult center at Bubastis drew pilgrims from all Egypt, and cats — her sacred animals — were mummified by the thousand in her honor.
